## Services Offered
- **Web Design:** UI/UX research, wireframing, high-fidelity Figma prototyping, interactive design systems, and responsive design.
- **Website Development:** High-performance landing pages, full-stack web applications, custom business websites, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
- **Branding & Logo Design:** Brand strategy, visual identity systems, vector logo design, typography curation, brand guidelines, and collateral design.

## Core Technical Skills
- **Frontend:** React, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Motion / Framer Motion, Lenis Smooth Scroll.
- **Design & Prototyping:** Figma, UI/UX Research, Design Systems, Vector Graphics, Wireframing.
- **Full-Stack & Tools:** Node.js, REST APIs, Git / GitHub, Firebase, Formspree, SEO Optimization, Web Performance Optimization.
